newsitem.title: UK: Western International Media expands to Netherlands.
newsitem.headline: Western International Media expands to Netherlands.

text.p: Western International Media Europe, a British-based media-buying group, announced on Monday it had expanded operations and had a new presence in the Netherlands.

Western International Media, which was formed in March through a partnership involving two media specialists and an advertising network, said it had acquired a minority stake in Media Independent, a media specialist in Amsterdam.
Media specialists, planners and buyers advise companies on where to spend their advertising budgets and they book media space on behalf of clients.

"It is through such partnerships that we can establish Western International Media as a strong creative and dynamic network across Europe, as well as maintaining a credible presence in each separate market," Mike Smallwood, Western International Media's chief executive, said in a statement.

The Western International Media partnership groups the Lowe Group advertising network and Initiative Media Worldwide, which are owned by Interpublic in New York, and Western International Media, a sister media network in the United States.
Media Independent in Amsterdam was set up in 1993 and buys media air time on behalf of clients including Mercedes-Benz Netherlands, perfume house Christian Dior and Rover Netherlands.
Media Independent would be renamed Western International Media (Netherlands).

Media Independent director Adri Ulfman said, "With Western we will benefit from a partnership with an influential international media network, without having to compromise our identity or the way we operate."
